adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx onError, `message` is built as a template literal: ```${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}```. In JS/TS this expression always produces a non-empty string (at minimum `": "`, or more typically `"undefined: ..."`), which is truthy. Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never use the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback added to common.json, and may display an unhelpful `undefined:` prefix instead.
